criteria.description: States that plugins declared directly by an active config file must resolve relative to that config file's directory rather than the project root.
States that plugins declared by a config loaded through `extends` must resolve relative to the extending config file's directory rather than the shareable config package's own location.
States that ESLint must throw a conflict error when configs active for the same target file load one plugin from different physical locations.
States that the conflict error names the plugin and both config sources.
States that no conflict error is thrown when the same plugin resolves to the same physical file across all active configs for a target file.
States that resolvePluginsRelativeTo sets one shared plugin-resolution directory.
States that resolvePluginsRelativeTo suppresses conflicts caused by separate local installations.
States that config files applying to separate non-overlapping targets do not conflict.
States that each matching file must still produce a lint result.
States that when a plugin cannot be found and no override is set the error must report the directory of the config file whose plugin lookup failed rather than the process working directory.
States that changing the plugin installation used for a target must not change which configuration results apply to that target.
States that users should receive the plugin intended by each configuration, including inherited configurations, with an explicit exception for the --config option which resolves from cwd.
States that createContext must keep its current filePath result for identical providedType, providedName, providedFilePath, and providedMatchBasePath.
States that createContext must keep its current matchBasePath result for identical providedType, providedName, providedFilePath, and providedMatchBasePath.
States that createContext must keep its current name result for identical providedType, providedName, providedFilePath, and providedMatchBasePath.
States that createContext must keep its current type result for identical providedType, providedName, providedFilePath, and providedMatchBasePath.
Records that `createContext` in `lib/cli-engine/config-array-factory.js` takes `{ cwd }` as its first argument rather than a plain directory string.
Records that `CLIEngine` in `lib/cli-engine/cli-engine.js` accepts `resolvePluginsRelativeTo` as the shared directory override.
Records that `CascadingConfigArrayFactory` in `lib/cli-engine/cascading-config-array-factory.js` accepts `resolvePluginsRelativeTo`.
States that the conflict message reads `Plugin "<pluginId>" was conflicted between "<importerName1>" and "<importerName2>".`
States that the conflict error carries messageTemplate of "plugin-conflict".
States that the conflict error carries messageData.pluginId holding the plugin identifier string.
States that `messageData.plugins` holds `{ filePath, importerName }` records listed from higher to lower configuration precedence.
Records the importerName value as the config file's relative path from cwd for a regular config file.
Records the importerName value as "--config" for a file given through configFile.
Records the importerName value as "CLIOptions" for plugins given through the plugins option.
Records that _loadPlugin sets relativeToDirectory to resolvePluginsRelativeTo || ctx.matchBasePath.
Records that the ConfigArrayFactory constructor stores path.resolve(cwd, resolvePluginsRelativeTo) when the override is given.
Records that checkPluginConflicts(configArray, filePath) was added to lib/cli-engine/cascading-config-array-factory.js.
Records that getConfigArrayForFile calls checkPluginConflicts before returning.
Records that messages/plugin-conflict.txt names the plugin.
Records that messages/plugin-conflict.txt names the filePath of each conflicting record.
Records that messages/plugin-conflict.txt names the importerName of each conflicting record.
Records that the plugin-missing `messageData` reports `resolvePluginsRelativeTo: relativeToDirectory`.
Records that the empty fixture `tests/fixtures/config-hierarchy/broken/plugins/node_modules/eslint-plugin-example.js` was added.
Records that the test was renamed to should load the plugin from the directory of the config file.
Records that the renamed test expects subdir/node_modules/eslint-plugin-subdir/index.js.
Records that new plugin-conflict test suites were added to tests/lib/cli-engine/cli-engine.js under executeOnFiles().
Records that new plugin-conflict test suites were added to tests/lib/cli-engine/cascading-config-array-factory.js.
Records that the repository is ESLint `7.0.0-alpha.2`.
Records that defineCascadingConfigArrayFactoryWithInMemoryFileSystem in tests/lib/cli-engine/_utils.js accepts { cwd: () => root, files }.
Records that defineCascadingConfigArrayFactoryWithInMemoryFileSystem in tests/lib/cli-engine/_utils.js stubs ModuleResolver.
Records that defineCLIEngineWithInMemoryFileSystem in tests/lib/cli-engine/_utils.js accepts { cwd: () => root, files }.
Records that defineCLIEngineWithInMemoryFileSystem in tests/lib/cli-engine/_utils.js stubs ModuleResolver.
States that `bin/eslint.js` renders `../messages/${err.messageTemplate}.txt` through `lodash.template`.
States that `resolvePluginsRelativeTo` defaults to `cwd` in the `CascadingConfigArrayFactory` constructor.

Explains that `ctx.matchBasePath` was locked as the plugin resolution base when no override is set because it survives the `{ ...ctx, filePath, name }` spread and keeps `extends` plugins on the extending config file's directory.
Explains that `ctx.filePath` was rejected as the resolution base because a decoy plugin copy inside a shareable config package would win.
Explains that a new context field was rejected because the required `createContext` parameters name no such field.
Records that checkPluginConflicts walks elements last-to-first for highest precedence first.
Records that checkPluginConflicts skips elements failing element.criteria.test(filePath).
Records that checkPluginConflicts skips plugin records with no filePath.
Records that checkPluginConflicts keeps the first record per plugin id.
Records that checkPluginConflicts throws when a later record has a different filePath.

Explains that the permanent conflict tests use try/catch with `assert.fail("Expected to throw an error")` rather than `assert.throws` because this repo's chai rejects function matchers with `TypeError: errorLike is not a constructor`.

Explains that the cascading suite's same-physical-file test defines a second `files` object without the `subdir` plugin copy rather than nulling one entry because `initFiles` in `tests/lib/cli-engine/_utils.js` recurses into any object value and would throw on `null`.
Explains that the old project-root plugin test was rewritten because it asserted old behavior.
Records that the `shared` fixtures under `tests/fixtures/config-hierarchy` use `extends` and not plugins so the conflict check does not affect them.
Records that under matchBasePath the --config file's plugins resolve from cwd via basePath: cwd.
Records that CLIOptions plugins resolve from cwd because they carry no filePath.
Records that the implementation edits are complete.
Records that the test edits are complete except for the failing resolvePluginsRelativeTo test in tests/lib/cli-engine/cli-engine.js.
Contains at most 16600 characters.
